about_the_game:
Join the courageous underground network of Book Smugglers in a grim decision-making, point-and-click, resource-management adventure as they risk everything to preserve their cultural heritage and ignite a flame of resistance.

Manage your resources
Strategically manage your limited supplies, such as food, tools, currency and forged documents. Your choices will determine the success of your missions and the safety of the precious literature you transport.


Make tough decisions
Experience the weight of your decisions as you balance risk and reward. Every choice has multiple outcomes that might influence your gameplay differently every time you play. Your choices will shape the Book Smugglers' destiny and leave a lasting impact on the pages of history.


Ignite a flame of resistance
Explore the intriguing phenomenon of book smuggling in a time of oppression in 19th-century Lithuania. Learn about the brave individuals who risked their lives to keep their cultural heritage alive and fight against the suppression of knowledge.
